stage: Mahakal II / calibrated-forward and innovation-aware inverse pilot 002
purpose: Two separated experiments. A real Schwarzschild ray-primitive calibration, and a manufactured source-inverse stress test; NOT a combined validated Kerr reconstruction.
preflight: Before registration, five scalar Schwarzschild closest approaches were checked by radial quadrature and orbit ODE to test reference implementation; these are development points, not holdout.

physical_forward.metric: Schwarzschild M=1, a=0; ray in its conserved orbital plane
physical_forward.integral: total round-trip coordinate time and angular sweep from sphere r=100, via simple exterior radial turn and back to r=100
reference_pair: factored radial definite quadrature with r=rt+s^2
DOP853 integration of orbit and coordinate-time ODE with event stop
physical_forward.training_positions: uniform in log(d), same for all candidates
physical_forward.detector: 12 log(d)-spaced pixel intervals with exact db/dlog(d) Jacobian and full db width whitening; 5 fields (constant,cos/sin delays for periods20,40)
physical_forward.leading_delay: -6*sqrt(3)*log(d/2), from expansion near r=3; remainder learned, not assumed zero
metrics: delay point error against independent ODE
maximum per-channel whitened detector relative error
physical_forward.scope: Calibrates physical ray delay primitive only, not source crossings, redshift, emission support or rotating-Kerr transfer.

inverse.renderer: same manufactured three distributed-delay maps as pilot001, not the physical_forward scattering map
inverse.neural_representation: same periodic-feature MLP with two32-unit tanh layers for all methods
inverse.robust_penalty: min_s (z-s)^2+2*abs(s) = Huber threshold1, z=(dt j+0.8*dphi j)/0.05; s=soft_threshold(z,1)
inverse.selection: each physics method chooses one global lambda by mean independent validation-observation chi2, not source truth; freeze selected lambdas before test outcomes
inverse.test_construction: two independently drawn background coefficient sets, each with matched, single-event and double-event history; parameters differ from validation; double-event class absent from validation
acquisitions: direct-only fits once per shared background, reused for all three indistinguishable old-history variants
inverse.classical_control: Fourier times cubic-time-spline ridge, selected by training-data GCV only; predefined before this pilot
inverse.primary_metric: older-source contrast j-1 relative L2 on t in [-0.95,-0.38]
secondary: transient contrast error and recovered event norm
inverse.statistical_scope: six histories and three noise/initialization seeds; seeds not independent astrophysical histories; no population confidence interval

preservation: new experiment directory, no changes to Paper I or old pilot; every fit and failed reference recorded, no objective or threshold change after holdout inspection
gate: Failure of physical reference check blocks neural calibration; negative candidate results preserved. No future experiment automatically authorized by a positive pilot.
